reading.body:
Dataverge operates a carrier-neutral data center in Brooklyn at 882 3rd Ave within the Industry City complex, configured to support high-density AI workloads with cabinets rated for 100 plus kilowatts each and direct access to 40 plus carriers. The operator has not published total square footage or IT power capacity, so the size of this facility and its potential scale for AI deployment cannot be determined from available specifications.

New York state shows 31 mapped data center facilities, but only one facility has published power capacity figures in operator specifications, and Dataverge ranks second by published megawatts in the state, indicating that capacity transparency across New York's data center base remains sparse and this facility's actual power draw is not disclosed.

Without published power figures, this campus cannot be placed in any meaningful ranking of AI infrastructure by scale, though its carrier-neutral design and dense cabinet specifications position it as a potential site for AI workloads if sufficient power is available on-site.
